reviews.comment: George is personable and paced; he takes his time with in-depth lectures that do an excellent job covering the information. Lectures are supplemented with Zybooks readings that are lengthy but useful. He does not post anything online: homework/test grades, lecture materials, etc. Attend the lectures for the best understanding, he runs them well.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Pharr is a great teacher, the textbook is really solid. You must attend class, as there is lecture only content that is tested over.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: honestly MSEN 201 is generally pretty difficult regardless of who you took it with. That said Dr Pharr is easily one of the best professors I've had thus far. His lectures are great, tests are brutal but the curve's pretty good, homeworks not terrible. Great guy and a fantastic professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is very difficult. Everything is on paper and no lectures are posted online, so it's very important to have good attendance. He is hilarious and precious, anyone would be lucky to have him as a professor. He explains topics very well, and even brings examples (be ready for a blow torch). Overall, tough but amazing!!!

By far one of the best college classes I have taken. Class was engaging, I learned something every time I was in the classroom, and I am totally engaged throughout the lecture. Dr. Pharr is an amazing professor and I wish more were as passionate and able to communicate ideas like him.
PHARR IS THE GOAT GOT A C CAUSE IM BRAINDEAD

Absolutely love Pharr. Amazing lecturer, legend in the field. Communicates extremely complicated topics very clearly, and is honestly just a normal guy who happens to be extremely intelligent. PAY ATTENTION IN LECTURE. If you do, exams will be MUCH easier. An A is very possible, just pay attention and enjoy yourself.

This course is very dense, but if you attend every lecture it will be easier to navigate. There are weekly homeworks based on the textbook, so the textbook is required. The exams are pretty intense, but he curves generously based on the class performance. Patrick Shamberger also has lectures on YouTube for further understanding, but Pharr is great.

90% of the class grade is based on tests, but he accounts for this with a very fair curve. Reading the textbook and paying attention to small details in class is important. I'm glad to be finished with this class because it's arguably the hardest I've taken in college so far, but if I could have Dr. Pharr again for another class I definitely would.
Pretty hard tests but the curve is huge. One of the most interesting classes I've taken. Dr.Pharr is awesome

Dr. Pharr is the best professor I've had. He actually cares about how you do in the class and he's really fair on his tests. This class was difficult at times, but he makes it so worth it. I would 100% take his class again. He works hard to make his lectures engaging even though there's a lot of material to cover. Homework is also actually helpful

He brings lots of visual references that help you understand the materials. His exams are mostly conceptual problems, so make sure to read a textbook (as he always asks us to do). Homeworks are difficult, and there's going to be no feedback for the homework unless you go to his office hour. Tough grader, but a generous curve.

A lot a lot of material covered in this class. He makes it as easy as possible but it still is very lecture heavy. His exams are very T/F so its easy to miss. Have to know all material well for 100% on the T/F. Design problems arent too hard just work as a group and google stuff. Overall good professor for such an intensive course

Dr. Pharr is a great prof, even though I've never really liked the materials side of mechanical engineering, he makes it entertaining. His class quizzes and tests weren't too bad. This class is an easy B.

Dr. Pharr makes this introductory class so clear and interesting. He has a really straightforward way of teaching and he cares about his students. Reading the book is the easiest way to do good in this class, his lectures are taken from it. He is a really great professor. He will curve all exams, as the averages tend to be low.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Pharr's lectures are great! You learn a lot by going to class and paying attention. The tests are difficult but have a steep curve. Overall hes a great guy that loves what he teaches.
